top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks unite the magic-wavelength lattice architecture with defining experimental development into an independently reproducible measurement capability near 10^-18 precision. Their maturity makes controlled atoms a durable probe of fundamental effects, provided recognition is confined to the originating lattice-clock achievement rather than later advances across optical metrology.
